mapper.select:
select
from dm_change_item where owner_uid = #{ownerUid} and ref_change_id = #{refChangeId} and ref_change_item_type = #{itemType} order by content_index asc

select current_item.id, current_item.owner_uid, current_item.ref_flow_id, current_item.ref_change_id, current_item.ref_change_item_type, current_item.content_name, current_item.content_index from dm_change_item current_item left join dm_change_flow_item baseline on baseline.owner_uid = current_item.owner_uid and baseline.ref_flow_id = #{flowId} and baseline.content_name = current_item.content_name where current_item.owner_uid = #{ownerUid} and current_item.ref_change_id = #{changeId} and current_item.ref_change_item_type = 'SQL' and (baseline.id is null or not (baseline.content <=> current_item.content)) union all select baseline.id, baseline.owner_uid, baseline.ref_flow_id, #{changeId}, 'SQL', baseline.content_name, baseline.content_index from dm_change_flow_item baseline left join dm_change_item current_item on current_item.owner_uid = baseline.owner_uid and current_item.ref_change_id = #{changeId} and current_item.ref_change_item_type = 'SQL' and current_item.content_name = baseline.content_name where baseline.owner_uid = #{ownerUid} and baseline.ref_flow_id = #{flowId} and current_item.id is null order by content_index asc
